access_boundary: This record represents the Gemini 3.1 Flash TTS preview identified by the model code gemini-3.1-flash-tts-preview, launched April 15, 2026 per the changelog, marked legacy, and listed with an earliest shutdown date of November 17, 2026 and the Gemini 3.8 TTS models as replacements. The Gemini 3.8 Flash and Flash-Lite TTS releases, the Gemini 2.5 TTS lines, and the Gemini app products remain separate model or service boundaries.

tradeoffs: No developer-published weights are available for self-operation
